# The CL fork watch's rule constants and Sepolia vectors, pinned identically by
# BOTH engines' tests: Java ClForkWatchTest.constantsMatchTheSharedTwinPins and
# Rust cl_fork_watch::tests::constants_match_the_shared_twin_pins. The rule
# constants are the EL watch's (rust/testdata/el/fork_watch/params.txt) — one
# vote, one majority, one freshness for both detectors. Change a value here AND
# in both engines, or a suite fails.
min_peers=3
observation_ttl_seconds=86400
activation_grace_seconds=21600
max_horizon_seconds=34560000
max_tracked=512
# The CL watch runs on every network (the EL watch is still staged).
enabled_networks=mainnet,sepolia,gnosis
# Sepolia: the Fulu digest with BPO2 folded in (live wire value), the Gloas
# digest the same blob params yield, and Glamsterdam's activation (epoch 353024).
sepolia_fulu_digest=0x74d01459
sepolia_gloas_digest=0x669e6c11
sepolia_gloas_activation=1791294816
